knowledge:
- key_parameters: input=A SpatialExperiment object containing the spatially resolved transcriptomics data ;; family=The distribution family to use, such as poisson or poisson() for raw counts, or gaussian() for log-transformed normalized data ;; assay_name=The name of the assay in the input object to use for modeling (e.g., "counts" or "logcounts") ;; offset=A numeric vector to account for technical variation, typically the natural log of the library size (log(spe$total)) or size factors (log(spe$sizeFactor)) ;; X=A vector or design matrix of covariates (e.g., tissue anatomy or cell type composition) to adjust for in the model
- alternatives: nnSVG=A Gaussian-based SVG detection method. tpSVG with a Poisson distribution is preferred over nnSVG because it avoids the mean-rank relationship bias that tends to over-prioritize highly expressed genes over lowly expressed genes
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing spatially resolved transcriptomics data (e.g., 10x Visium, seqFISH) to identify spatially variable genes, especially when dealing with low-expressed genes or when wanting to adjust for known anatomical/biological covariates
- pitfalls: Forgetting to apply the natural log function to the offset parameter (e.g., using spe$total instead of log(spe$total)), which is critical to ensure the data scale is conformable ;; Failing to remove missing values (NAs) from covariates before running covariate-adjusted models, which will cause model fitting failures (use complete.cases to filter the SpatialExperiment object first)

workflows.name: poisson_count_model
workflows.intent: Detect spatially variable genes from raw count spatially resolved transcriptomics data using a Poisson model.
input: spe (SpatialExperiment object containing raw gene expression counts and spatial coordinates)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate the library size (total counts) per spot/cell ;; 2. Run tpSVG with a Poisson family, specifying the raw counts assay and the log-transformed library size as an offset ;; 3. Retrieve the SVG statistics and p-values from the rowData of the returned object
workflows.code:
spe$total <- counts(spe) |> colSums()
spe_poisson  <- tpSVG(
  spe,
  family = poisson,
  assay_name = "counts",
  offset = log(spe$total)   # Natural log library size
)

rowData(spe_poisson)

workflows.name: covariate_adjusted_model
workflows.intent: Detect spatially variable genes while adjusting for known biological covariates (such as tissue anatomy or cell type composition).
input: spe (SpatialExperiment object containing raw gene expression counts, spatial coordinates, and covariate annotations in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify and remove cells/spots with missing covariate data using complete.cases ;; 2. Extract the covariate vector or design matrix ;; 3. Run tpSVG with the covariate matrix X, Poisson family, and log-transformed library size offset
workflows.code:
# Check missing data
idx_complete_case <- complete.cases(spe$ground_truth)
# If multiple covariates
# idx_complete_case <- complete.cases(spe$ground_truth, spe$cell_count)

# Remove missing data
spe <- spe[, idx_complete_case]

# Create a design matrix
x <- spe$ground_truth 

spe_poisson_cov  <- tpSVG(
  spe,
  X = x, 
  family = poisson,
  assay_name = "counts",
  offset = log(spe$total)   # Natural log library size
)
